description: QC-022 fused bond on secp256k1: post q_hex (uncompressed 04-prefixed pubkey hex) and optionally A (private face, 64-hex or decimal). Projects ground = A*G and grades the pair by verify_presented_pair (WIN iff A*G == Q; x(Q) alone is UNPRESENTED_PAIR). Deterministic, zero floats, does not ECDLP.
name: bond_presented_key
